tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Screen background (warm cream). Also the background of bottom sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards, list groups, inputs, and the round icon buttons over photos.

tokens.name: surface-soft
tokens.usage: Soft fills: secondary buttons, unselected pills, segmented-control tracks, chef's tips, ingredient highlights in steps.

tokens.name: honey
tokens.usage: Warm accent: active tab, timer start buttons, step number badges, the latest-recipe tag. Always with ink text, never white.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Calm positive fill: temperature checks, AI hints, 'Variant' tags, confirmations, presence pill. Ink or olive-deep text.

tokens.name: olive
tokens.usage: Primary action and selection: olive buttons, selected pills and months, switch on, checkboxes, the current step. White text on it; as text, links on surface-page or surface-card.

tokens.name: olive-deep
tokens.usage: Link hover, text on sage, outline-button text.

tokens.name: olive-muted
tokens.usage: Completed segments in progress bars (form sections, cooking steps). Decorative only, never text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text. Also the dark surfaces: main call-to-action buttons, tab bar, segmented tabs, timer card.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, hints, descriptions, section overlines.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Struck-through items that are already done (ticked groceries). Low contrast on purpose; never for content someone must read.

tokens.name: ink-raised
tokens.usage: Buttons that sit on an ink surface (the -1 / +1 buttons in the timer card).

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Icons and unselected labels on ink (tab bar, dark segmented tabs, timer card label).

tokens.name: on-olive
tokens.usage: Text and icons on olive, ink and danger fills.

tokens.name: peach
tokens.usage: Recipe photo placeholder.

tokens.name: peach-ink
tokens.usage: Text on peach (placeholder labels).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Row dividers inside white cards (1.5px).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders (2px), empty progress segments, outlined chips.

tokens.name: line-dashed
tokens.usage: Dashed border of 'Add …' buttons (2px dashed).

tokens.name: line-handle
tokens.usage: Bottom-sheet handle and the switch track when off.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Warning fills: 'To buy' and 'Missing' tags, a field with a problem, the delete dialog icon disc.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warning text on warn-soft, surface-card or surface-page; the 'Chef's tip' label; 'Not allowed' is ink-muted, not warn.

tokens.name: warn-border
tokens.usage: 2px border of a field or card that needs attention. Border only, never text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions only: delete buttons and 'Delete this recipe' links. White text on it.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind bottom sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: member-honey
tokens.usage: Member color 1 (default for the first member). Ink text and initials on it.

tokens.name: member-rose
tokens.usage: Member color 2.

tokens.name: member-sky
tokens.usage: Member color 3.

tokens.name: member-mint
tokens.usage: Member color 4.

tokens.name: member-lilac
tokens.usage: Member color 5.

tokens.name: member-peach
tokens.usage: Member color 6.

tokens.name: member-pistachio
tokens.usage: Member color 7.

tokens.name: member-clay
tokens.usage: Member color 8. After 8 members the palette repeats; initials keep people apart.

tokens.name: member-everyone
tokens.usage: Events for the whole family ('Everyone', label 'All'). Brighter than any member color on purpose.

tokens.name: member-others
tokens.usage: Events for people outside the family ('Others', person icon). Always with a 1px line-handle outline so it shows on white.

tokens.name: member-removed
tokens.usage: Past events of a member who left the family.

tokens.name: calendar-today-tint
tokens.usage: Today's column in the week grid.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Screen titles on tab screens (Home greeting, Recipes, Groceries, Settings, Timers).

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Recipe titles, cooking-mode step titles, titles of pushed screens.

styles.name: timer
styles.usage: Timer clocks. Always with tabular numerals.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: The big number in a stat tile.

styles.name: title-sm
styles.usage: Section headings, step names, brand wordmark.

styles.name: label-lg
styles.usage: Text of 58-60px buttons; recipe names in lists.

styles.name: body-cook
styles.sample: Melt 20 g butter over medium heat.
styles.usage: Step instructions in cooking mode, read from arm's length.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Add 2 leeks (300 g) finely sliced and cook until soft.
styles.usage: Step instructions on the recipe page.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Row labels, field values, descriptions. The smallest size for anything a person must act on.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Silky custard, sweet leeks and a crisp crust.
styles.usage: Supporting text, meta lines, callout text, secondary button labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Hints under fields and switches, sub-lines in rows.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase group labels above lists (aisles, sections). Write the text in sentence case; uppercase comes from the style.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Text inside tags and small badges only.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Inside segmented tracks; gap between a label and its sub-line.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between grid cells (months, progress segments) and between stacked field parts.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between pills, chips and side-by-side small buttons.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between equal buttons in a button row; icon to text in callouts.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap inside a card between its blocks; gap between list cards.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Row horizontal padding inside list groups; callout padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Card padding; side margin of the floating tab bar.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Gap between sections on a screen.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter. Every screen uses it.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Top padding of the content sheet under a photo; dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Bottom padding above the home indicator on screens with a fixed footer.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Inline ingredient highlights inside step text.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Items inside a segmented control.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Small square controls: segmented tracks, 'more' button, small inputs (12-14px).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Inputs, timer buttons, callouts, photo thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards and list groups.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Hero cards (Latest recipe), timer cards, recipe hero corners.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets and of the content sheet over a recipe photo.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, pills, tags, the tab bar, avatars, switches.

tokens.name: shadow-segment
tokens.usage: The selected item of a light segmented control.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating elements over content: the timer pill.

tokens.name: shadow-nav
tokens.usage: The floating tab bar.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable. No exceptions.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Small buttons, pills, segmented items, steppers, icon buttons.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Text inputs, search, secondary full-width buttons.

tokens.name: control-xl
tokens.usage: Primary full-width buttons at the bottom of screens and sheets (60px in cooking mode).

tokens.name: tabbar-height
tokens.usage: Floating tab bar height; it sits 26px above the bottom edge.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Tab bar and stat-tile icons. Stroke 2-2.2px, round caps and joins.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside buttons, callouts and pills.

tokens.name: screen-width
tokens.usage: Design width (iPhone 14/15). Layouts stretch fluidly; on web, content is capped at 720px wide.

tokens.name: opacity-dimmed
tokens.usage: Steps that are not the current one in cooking mode; a photo while it uploads.
